# DRF — GitHub AI Bootstrap

This file is intentionally thin. Root `AGENTS.md` is universal governance; **`tbhrc/skills` is the sole editable reusable Skill canon**.

Before substantive work:

1. Read root `AGENTS.md`.
2. Read `skills/README.md` for DRF-to-central routing.
3. Select the single best canonical Skill in `tbhrc/skills` and read its `SKILL.md` before acting.
4. Resolve/create the governing GitHub Issue before durable substantive changes.
5. Treat current repository files and verified evidence as more authoritative than chat/model memory.

## Skill routing

- New business opportunity / market intelligence / scoring / niches / underwriting / V3 close-out → `https://github.com/tbhrc/skills/tree/main/drf-opportunity-factory`
- Discovery / daily portfolio calibration / scheduled refresh / specialist intelligence → `https://github.com/tbhrc/skills/tree/main/automations-drf-intelligence`
- Dashboard V3 / website / data-contract / Pages work → `https://github.com/tbhrc/skills/tree/main/drf-dashboard-operations`
- Business development / targeting / outreach / pipeline / Won handoff → `https://github.com/tbhrc/skills/tree/main/drf-business-development`
- Repository execution / lifecycle → `https://github.com/tbhrc/skills/tree/main/github-agent-workflow`
- Skill creation / migration / maintenance → `https://github.com/tbhrc/skills/tree/main/github-skill-builder`
- GitHub architecture / capability selection → `https://github.com/tbhrc/skills/tree/main/github-power-user`

Local `skills/drf-*/SKILL.md` paths are compatibility/migration pointers only, not editable reusable owners.

Do not create global templates, AI workflows, SOPs, lessons, prompt files or miscellaneous knowledge folders. Improve the owning central Skill instead.

## Material opportunity close-out

Material opportunity/niche research must finish through the canonical DRF Opportunity Factory Skill:

```text
authoritative source
→ affected registers
→ Layer 3/current dossier where required
→ businesses/PORTFOLIO-V3.md LAST
   OR businesses/V3-RECONCILIATIONS.md explicit NO FIELD CHANGE
→ validation
```

Never use `index.html` as the business-data write path.

## Change path

Use the canonical `github-agent-workflow` and choose the lowest sufficient lane. Level 0 / direct `main` remains the normal path for safe bounded changes; branches/PRs are used only when isolation materially adds value.

## Security

Never expose or commit secrets, credentials, private keys, payment data or unapproved customer personal data.
